description: Which locale a component uses when the app may give none, language-neutral. Inputs: `app`, the locale the app gives (a locale provider or a prop), and `context`, the locale around the app (on the web the page's `lang`, in Flutter the app's Locale from Localizations); null when absent. The app's locale wins, then the context's, then the default: the catalog's language with the CLDR world (001) and ISO 8601 conventions. Outputs: `source`, the input that decided; `weekStart`, the first day of the week, 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday; `hourCycle`, 12 or 24. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.
